mapper.insert: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS upgrade_tasks ( id INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, task_id varchar NOT NULL, configuration ${JSON_TYPE} NOT NULL, status varchar DEFAULT NULL, created TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_updated TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM upgrade_tasks ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1;
mapper.update: UPDATE upgrade_tasks SET task_id = #{taskId}, configuration = #{configuration}, last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id};
UPDATE upgrade_tasks SET status = #{status}, last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId};
